picks.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Introducing hands-on editing in the Adobe plugin for ChatGPT
picks.excerpt: Announced at OpenAI DevDay 2026: Adobe's ChatGPT plugin gains interactive, hands-on editors for images, designs and PDFs, powered by Photoshop and Adobe Express, so users can describe an edit in chat and then fine-tune it by hand in the panel. (page gives date only: 09-29-2026)
picks.rationale: The DevDay story that most directly affects design work: Photoshop and Express editors now open inside ChatGPT, so you can prompt an edit and then fine-tune it by hand. Primary source, and it covers the TechCrunch plugin-UI story too.

picks.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
picks.excerpt: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Sept 28, 2026): 30%+ faster and up to 30% cheaper than Sonnet 5. It is strongest on everyday tasks and polished documents, slides and spreadsheets, and Anthropic says it has 'a sharp eye for design'. (page gives date only)
picks.rationale: A new model release that is faster and cheaper, pitched on design-quality output for docs and slides. It changes which model designers pick for AI-built UI and decks tomorrow.

picks.title: How to de-slopify your designs
picks.excerpt: Tips for anyone who vibecodes: people can spot and dislike AI slop but don't know how to fix it. This piece gives designers concrete ways to de-slopify AI-generated interfaces. (date/body from the Medium RSS feed; site is Cloudflare-walled)
picks.rationale: Hands-on fixes for generic AI-generated UI that designers can use right away. It is a fresh take, not the older de-slop pieces already published (Builder.io codebase, dev.to landing-page).

picks.title: OpenAI's new dots agents come with a crew of friendly mascots
picks.excerpt: A design read on OpenAI's new dots agents: instead of the void logo, each dot gets a cute, blobby character design (a triangle with a bow tie, a bunny and others), a deliberate branding shift for agentic AI. (date/body from the FC RSS feed; site returns 403)
picks.rationale: The second DevDay angle, a design critique of character branding for AI agents. It is a different story from the Adobe plugin and from the 9/27 Meta Muse 'kawaii' piece.

picks.title: Hands-on: Meta's Hologram avatars for VR and display glasses
picks.excerpt: Hands-on with Meta's 'Hologram' avatars from Connect: voice-driven, AI-infused 2.5D photoreal avatars that Meta positions against Apple Personas for its VR and display glasses.
picks.rationale: A hands-on look at a new AI avatar system for spatial and XR interfaces. It is a different story from the Muse agent card claimed by gadgets, and it keeps the VR category in the mix.
